gate: Lightning is the closest natural fact for this code. A sudden break in the ordinary current, after which the room is not the same room. As a gate, it carries the body's capacity to take a shock and stay standing, and more than that, to use the shock as a door. The misread is to think this is bravado, the swagger of someone who likes the edge. It is not. The drive is older and quieter. There is a part of the body that knows the only way some thresholds get crossed is by force, by an event that rearranges the ground under a person without their permission. This code is the willingness to be that event for others, and the willingness to be on the receiving end when life arranges it that way. Either side of the lightning, the work is the same. Stay upright. Let the strike clean what it cleans.
centre_field: The will is the body's smallest centre and one of its most concentrated. A red triangle off to the right, motor energy concerned with the material world, the felt sense of I can do this thing I said I would do. Placement matters here. Shock sits in the centre of capacity, not in the centre of mind or feeling, which is the whole teaching. The strike has to be backed by something. Without the motor under it, shock would just be noise, a loud event with no follow-through. The will is what lets the code endure its own lightning. It is also what makes the code carry weight when it lands in another person. There is a body behind the disruption, a steadiness that says the break is survivable because the one delivering it has already survived it. Capacity is the ground the shock stands on.
channel: Standing by itself, this code can disrupt but cannot direct. The strike lands, the ground shifts, and then what. There is no inner compass in the shock alone, no read on whether the disruption served anything or was simply destructive. The reach is across the body, into the gate of the spirit of the self, the still central point that holds love of what is. Together the two form the channel of initiation. The shock without that centre is violence. The centre without the shock is contemplation that never gets tested. Initiation is the joining: a disruption aimed by a steady heart, a break that has somewhere to deliver the broken to. Alone, this code is a hammer with no target. Joined, it becomes the rite that breaks a person open into a wider life. The lightning needs the still place to land in, or it just burns the field.
